dialogues.jp: 「いただきま〜す」
dialogues.en: "......It tastes good."
dialogues.text: "......It tastes good."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Does it?"
dialogues.text: "Does it?"

dialogues.jp:
今夜の献立は、オムライスのデミグラスソース
かけと、カボチャのスープ、大根サラダだった。
dialogues.en: She looks a little bit nervous but she finally smiles.
dialogues.text: She looks a little bit nervous but she finally smiles.

dialogues.jp: （どんどん、本格的になっていくな……）
dialogues.en: "Ah...... I wasn't sure about the demiglace sauce......"
dialogues.text: "Ah...... I wasn't sure about the demiglace sauce......"

dialogues.jp:
にわかに、自分が座っているのが、レストラン
の椅子なんじゃないかって錯覚に襲われる。
dialogues.en: "It's delicious."
dialogues.text: "It's delicious."

dialogues.jp:
ともかく俺は、オムライスの一角をスプーンで
切り崩した。
dialogues.en: She releases a sigh of relief and picks up a spoon.
dialogues.text: She releases a sigh of relief and picks up a spoon.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「本当ですか？」
dialogues.en:
"If you have anything you want to eat... please let me
know."
dialogues.text:
"If you have anything you want to eat... please let me
know."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「その……ソースの味の加減が、どうかなと思っ
　たんですけれども……」
dialogues.en: "I'll cook anything for you......"
dialogues.text: "I'll cook anything for you......"

dialogues.jp:
その言葉にホッと息をつき、頼子さんはスプー
ンを手にした。
dialogues.en: "Ah, yes, about that..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, yes, about that..."

dialogues.jp: カボチャのスープに口を付け、俺は言った。
dialogues.en:
I take a sip of the pumpkin soup --it also tastes good-- and
I say,
dialogues.text:
I take a sip of the pumpkin soup --it also tastes good-- and
I say,

dialogues.jp:
「頼子さんて、その……ほんとに、メイドをやっ
　ていたい？」
dialogues.en: "Yoriko-san, do you really want to continue being a maid?"
dialogues.text: "Yoriko-san, do you really want to continue being a maid?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「え？　そ、それは……」
dialogues.en: "What? You mean......"
dialogues.text: "What? You mean......"

dialogues.jp:
途端によぎった不安の影に、俺は慌てて首を振
る。
dialogues.en:
She looks anxious all of a sudden, so I quickly shake my
head.
dialogues.text:
She looks anxious all of a sudden, so I quickly shake my
head.

dialogues.jp:
「ああ、いや、そういう意味じゃなくてさ、た
　だ、その……」
dialogues.en: "Oh, no, I didn't mean that. But it's just......"
dialogues.text: "Oh, no, I didn't mean that. But it's just......"

dialogues.jp:
「うら若き乙女が、いつまでもやるような仕事
　でもないんじゃないかって思ったんだけど」
dialogues.en:
"I just thought working as a maid isn't a good job for a
young lady like you to do for such a long period."
dialogues.text:
"I just thought working as a maid isn't a good job for a
young lady like you to do for such a long period."

dialogues.jp:
冗談をまぶした感じで、笑顔で言ってみる。が、
頼子さんは沈んだ顔をしたままだ。
dialogues.en: I tell her with a smile. But she's still looking anxious.
dialogues.text: I tell her with a smile. But she's still looking anxious.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「わ、私は……その、ずっと、メイドを……」
dialogues.en: "I...... I want to...... continue......"
dialogues.text: "I...... I want to...... continue......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「その……出来たら、続けたいと思うんです」
dialogues.en: "......being a maid...... if it's okay with you......"
dialogues.text: "......being a maid...... if it's okay with you......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「そ、そう」
dialogues.en: "Oh, okay."
dialogues.text: "Oh, okay."

dialogues.jp:
その訴えかけるような視線に、俺はやや上体を
後ろに｛ひ／退｝いた。
dialogues.en:
She gives me a pleading look, so I slightly pull my upper
body away from her.
dialogues.text:
She gives me a pleading look, so I slightly pull my upper
body away from her.

dialogues.jp:
「ま、まあ、頼子さんがやりたいって言うなら、
　そりゃ構わないけど」
dialogues.en: "I mean, if that's what you want to do, I don't mind."
dialogues.text: "I mean, if that's what you want to do, I don't mind."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、ありがとうございます……」
dialogues.en: "Th-Thank you so much......"
dialogues.text: "Th-Thank you so much......"

dialogues.jp: 止まっていた食事が再開される。
dialogues.en:
We start to eat again. While I'm eating the radish salad,
I'm thinking...
dialogues.text:
We start to eat again. While I'm eating the radish salad,
I'm thinking...

dialogues.jp: サラダをしゃりしゃり食べながら、ふと思った。
dialogues.en: (But how long does she wants to be my maid......?)
dialogues.text: (But how long does she wants to be my maid......?)

dialogues.jp: （しかし、“ずっと”？　ずっとってのは……）
dialogues.en:
I glance at her. She seems to be looking at me as well and
quickly looks away.
dialogues.text:
I glance at her. She seems to be looking at me as well and
quickly looks away.

dialogues.jp:
ちらりと頼子さんを窺う。と、向こうもこちら
を見ていたらしく、すっと視線が弾け飛んだ。
dialogues.en: (......Oh well.)
dialogues.text: (......Oh well.)

dialogues.jp: （……ま、いっか）
dialogues.en:
I don't want to pursue it further. I don't want to sound
like I want to get rid of her from this house.
dialogues.text:
I don't want to pursue it further. I don't want to sound
like I want to get rid of her from this house.

dialogues.jp:
追及するのも気が引ける。何だか、頼子さんを
追い出したがっているようにも取れるしな。
dialogues.en:
(I just thought that it isn't a good idea for her to
continue being a maid if she wants to go to school......)
dialogues.text:
(I just thought that it isn't a good idea for her to
continue being a maid if she wants to go to school......)

dialogues.jp:
（学園に行きたいのなら、メイドであり続ける
　のはどうかと思っただけで……）
dialogues.en:
(Being with her all the time is what I wanted to do from the
beginning, and......)
dialogues.text:
(Being with her all the time is what I wanted to do from the
beginning, and......)

dialogues.jp:
（ずっと一緒に居るってのは、それは俺だって
　望んでいた事で……）

dialogues.en: I catch my breath and cover my mouth with my hand.
dialogues.text: I catch my breath and cover my mouth with my hand.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、あの……どうかしました？」
dialogues.en: "Wh-What's wrong......?"
dialogues.text: "Wh-What's wrong......?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、いや、何でもない……」
dialogues.en: "Oh, nothing......"
dialogues.text: "Oh, nothing......"

dialogues.jp: ごまかすように、皿に顔を向ける。
dialogues.en:
Pretending it's nothing, I search for something in my heart
while I look at the yellow soup.
dialogues.text:
Pretending it's nothing, I search for something in my heart
while I look at the yellow soup.

dialogues.jp:
黄色いスープを見つめながら、自分の心を探っ
ていた。
dialogues.en:
But I don't have to search for anything because I find the
emotion I'm looking for.
dialogues.text:
But I don't have to search for anything because I find the
emotion I'm looking for.

dialogues.jp:
探す必要なんてなかった。右も左も見ないうち
に、その感情はすぐに見つかった。
dialogues.en: That is...... @
dialogues.text: That is...... @

dialogues.jp: つまり──俺は、頼子さんが好きらしい。
dialogues.en: I think I love Yoriko-san.
dialogues.text: I think I love Yoriko-san.

dialogues.jp:
長年追い求めてきた宝物を見つけたような、泣
きたいような気分が胸を｛つ／衝｝いた。
dialogues.en:
As if I've just found a treasure I've been looking for for
years, the emotion I feel almost makes me want to cry.
dialogues.text:
As if I've just found a treasure I've been looking for for
years, the emotion I feel almost makes me want to cry.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「良かったです……。何か変なものでも入って
　いたかと……思いました」
dialogues.en: "Oh...... I thought you found something wrong in the soup."
dialogues.text: "Oh...... I thought you found something wrong in the soup."

dialogues.jp:
さっきの話の続きらしい。俺は心に向けていた
目を頼子さんに向けた。
dialogues.en:
She's still talking about the food. I change my focus from
my heart to her.
dialogues.text:
She's still talking about the food. I change my focus from
my heart to her.

dialogues.jp: 「変なものって？　隠し味とか？」
dialogues.en:
"What do you mean by wrong? Did you put a secret spice or
something?"
dialogues.text:
"What do you mean by wrong? Did you put a secret spice or
something?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「あ、いえ、そういう事ではなくて……その
　……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, no, that's not what I meant...... but......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, no, that's not what I meant...... but......"

dialogues.jp: もじもじと言いにくそうにする。
dialogues.en: She hesitates.
dialogues.text: She hesitates.

dialogues.jp:
「なっ、何だ？　そんな風にされると、気にな
　るって」
dialogues.en: "Wh-What is it? You are making me curious."
dialogues.text: "Wh-What is it? You are making me curious."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「は、はい、そのぉ……」

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「初めて料理した時に、その……小皿が一枚足
　りなくなっていて……」
dialogues.en:
"When I cooked for the first time, I...... think I lost a
very small plate......"
dialogues.text:
"When I cooked for the first time, I...... think I lost a
very small plate......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「え？　どういう事？」
dialogues.en: "What? What do you mean?"
dialogues.text: "What? What do you mean?"

dialogues.jp: 話がいまいち見えてこない。
dialogues.en: I can't understand.
dialogues.text: I can't understand.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「で、ですから、その……もしかしたら、料理
　の中に紛れ込んでしまったのかと……」
dialogues.en:
"I mean, I thought...... the small plate got into the
meal......"
dialogues.text:
"I mean, I thought...... the small plate got into the
meal......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「今日も、何かなくしたの？」
dialogues.en: "Did you lose something today, too?"
dialogues.text: "Did you lose something today, too?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「あ、いえ、今日はそんな事はないと、思うん
　です……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, no. I don't think so......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, no. I don't think so......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ふむ、じゃあＯＫだよ」
dialogues.en: "Well, then it's okay."
dialogues.text: "Well, then it's okay."

dialogues.jp:
だが、今夜がそうだとしても、小皿をなくした
その日もＯＫだったって事にはならない。
dialogues.en:
But it doesn't mean it's okay to lose something every other
day.
dialogues.text:
But it doesn't mean it's okay to lose something every other
day.

dialogues.jp:
（まあ、まさか、小皿を間違って食べる事はな
　いだろうが……）
dialogues.en:
(Oh, well. There's no way I could eat a small plate by
mistake......)
dialogues.text:
(Oh, well. There's no way I could eat a small plate by
mistake......)

dialogues.jp:
そう思う一方で、いつバリっという感触に出く
わすかに｛おび／怯｝えつつ、食事を続ける俺だった。
dialogues.en:
But even though I think it wouldn't happen, I'm still scared
to eat in case I bite a hard plate all of a sudden.
dialogues.text:
But even though I think it wouldn't happen, I'm still scared
to eat in case I bite a hard plate all of a sudden.

dialogues.jp: ◆恋愛感情◆
dialogues.en: ◆Junichi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Junichi◆

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんはいつまでメイドを続けるんだろう？
夕食時、俺がそう尋ねると、
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんは、ずっとメイドをやっていたいのだ
と言った。
dialogues.en:
Today's dinner is rice omelet with demiglace sauce, pumpkin
soup, and radish salad.
dialogues.text:
Today's dinner is rice omelet with demiglace sauce, pumpkin
soup, and radish salad.

dialogues.jp: ずっと……それは俺も望んでいたことだった。
dialogues.en: (She's getting better and better......)
dialogues.text: (She's getting better and better......)

dialogues.jp: そして、俺は気づいた。
dialogues.en: For a moment, I feel like I'm sitting on a restaurant chair.
dialogues.text: For a moment, I feel like I'm sitting on a restaurant chair.

dialogues.jp: 自分が頼子さんの事を好きであることに……。
dialogues.en: I cut the corner of the rice omelet with my spoon.
dialogues.text: I cut the corner of the rice omelet with my spoon.
